brief: Holds the house rules plus no-dead-code, the set that StzCheckProject runs over a whole directory.
detail: no-dead-code names a defined method or function that no recorded call reaches. It is name-based and cannot see a call through a variable, so it reports candidates and not proof; a graph without call edges yields nothing. The slow no-cyclic-calls rule is not here, so the set is cheap enough for a per-commit gate.
